level_one.title: Winter's Reach
level_one.description: Increase the range and travel speed of Frostbolt by 30%.

level_four.title: Arcane Intellect
level_four.description: Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.  Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

level_seven.title: Ice Lance
level_seven.description: Hitting a Chilled target with Frostbolt reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and restores 10 Mana.

level_ten.title: Ring of Frost
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

level_thirteen.title: Icy Veins
level_thirteen.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Numbing Blast
level_sixteen.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 0.75 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Cold Snap
level_twenty.description: The center area of Ring of Frost deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies after the outer ring expires. Each enemy Hero hit reduces its cooldown by 15 seconds.

level_one.title: Assimilation Mastery
level_one.description: Regeneration Globe healing grants 50 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields per second while active. While Assimilation is active, Kerrigan's Health and Mana regeneration is increased by 150%.

level_four.title: Psionic Pulse
level_four.description: Primal Grasp explodes a second time 2 seconds after its first explosion.

level_seven.title: Queen of Blades
level_seven.description: Reduce the cooldown of Ravage by 4 seconds and increase its damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 100%.

level_ten.title: Summon Ultralisk
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

level_thirteen.title: Psionic Barrier
level_thirteen.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

level_sixteen.title: Mounting Potency
level_sixteen.description: Ravage grants 5% Spell Power for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

level_twenty.title: Assimilation Blades
level_twenty.description: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

level_one.title: Heavy Pack
level_one.description: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.

level_four.title: Crystallize
level_four.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

level_seven.title: Induce Hibernation
level_seven.description: Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%.  When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avalanche
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

level_thirteen.title: Cooling Servos
level_thirteen.description: While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.  Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Fresh Powder
level_sixteen.description: Snow Blind gains an additional charge and its range is increased by 33%.

level_twenty.title: Cascade
level_twenty.description: While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

level_one.title: Inquisitor's Prayer
level_one.description: Searing Lash restores 25 Mana for each Hero it hits, and Zeal lasts 2 additional seconds.

level_four.title: Martyrdom
level_four.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level_seven.title: Intercession
level_seven.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

level_ten.title: Scarlet Aegis
level_ten.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Lashing Out
level_thirteen.description: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Harsh Discipline
level_sixteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Scarlet Crusade
level_twenty.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Ossein Renewal
level_one.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

level_four.title: Ghastly Reach
level_four.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

level_seven.title: Drain Momentum
level_seven.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Entomb
level_ten.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spectral Leech
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.

level_sixteen.title: Mithril Mace
level_sixteen.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.  Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

level_twenty.title: Buried Alive
level_twenty.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 (+4% per level) damage every 1 second.

level_one.title: Borean Winds
level_one.description: After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.  Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

level_four.title: Shattered Armor
level_four.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Icebound Fortitude
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.  Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Army of the Dead
level_ten.description: Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.  Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Deathchill
level_thirteen.description: Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers.  Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

level_sixteen.title: Remorseless Winter
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

level_twenty.title: Legion of Northrend
level_twenty.description: Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.  Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

level_one.title: Simple Geometry
level_one.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

level_four.title: Serrated Arrows
level_four.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_seven.title: Never Outmatched
level_seven.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Dragon's Arrow
level_ten.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ninja Assassin
level_thirteen.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Slayer
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 1.6% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_twenty.title: Play of the Game
level_twenty.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 (+4% per level) damage to each target hit by the impact.  Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.

level_one.title: Slumber Shells
level_one.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Overdose
level_four.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses. While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

level_seven.title: Night Terrors
level_seven.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

level_ten.title: Nano Boost
level_ten.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.  Cannot be used on Ana.

level_thirteen.title: Purifying Darts
level_thirteen.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

level_sixteen.title: Active Reload
level_sixteen.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

level_twenty.title: Nano Infusion
level_twenty.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

level_one.title: Sentinel Wisp
level_one.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

level_four.title: Nature's Culling
level_four.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

level_seven.title: Splintered Spear
level_seven.description: Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.  Splintered Spear deals 90 (+4% per level) damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

level_ten.title: Leaping Strike
level_ten.description: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Let Them Wither
level_thirteen.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

level_sixteen.title: Unfair Advantage
level_sixteen.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level_twenty.title: Intensifying Toxin
level_twenty.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

level_one.title: Enhanced Agility
level_one.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

level_four.title: One-Who-Collects
level_four.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_seven.title: Paralyzing Enzymes
level_seven.description: Drag Slows the target by 40% and reduces their healing received by 50% while active and for 2 seconds after ending. Dehaka's Basic Attacks increase the duration of the healing reduction to 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Isolation
level_ten.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Primal Swarm
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

level_sixteen.title: Pack Leader
level_sixteen.description: Dehaka gains 40 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 4 seconds after leaving.

level_twenty.title: Contagion
level_twenty.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target, but it deals 60% less damage to all targets.
